description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by bnd-0031. Every served surface is declared with its id, external version and access class, derived from what is emitted; the WebMCP declaration carries the three annotation flags per tool and the MCP declaration names the extension identifier.
note: added 2026-09-16 at rc.3 (DS-1); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.5 (PUB-6 Q55d and V9A-10; D100). Two defects: the vector asserts absolute `https://a.example/...` targets while its `input` states no base (Q55d), and it pins `agsc-surface-version: ["2026-09-15"]` for `webmcp` — the publication date of a **living** W3C Draft Community Group Report, which read "17 September 2026" on 2026-09-19 and moves again on every CG publish, so a node targeting the current draft failed a required vector. AGSC-11-16 as amended at rc.5 conforms **any** `YYYY-MM-DD`. Superseded by bnd-0031.
